title: Orchestrator identity hardening: bound claims to machine/session evidence
outcome: The shared control plane records and validates richer worker identity (stable worker ID + machine + session token) so two workers cannot accidentally operate under the same identity, stale-lease recovery becomes faster and safer, and the lease/state-machine logic in orchestrator-core is protected by its own unit tests.
before: Mandate 2026-08-27 (Governor parallel-delivery directive, section 14): until authenticated worker identity is implemented, identity rests on convention; claim supports --machine but nothing validates uniqueness or binds a session to a claim. orchestrator-core.mjs lease/claim logic has no dedicated unit tests. The Governor has separately reduced lease_ttl_minutes from 90 to 30 in .viro/orchestrator.json in this activation commit.
after: Claims carry machine + a per-session token; a second live claim under the same worker ID with different session evidence is refused with a clear error; stale-assignment detection is unit-tested; identity fields appear in briefs and the team board.
acceptance: Backward compatible: existing state files without session tokens still load and operate; a state written by the old code is readable by the new code.
Duplicate live identity (same worker ID, different session token, unexpired heartbeat) is refused with an explicit error.
Unit tests cover claim/lease/stale/reap logic in orchestrator-core, runnable via node --test without the product app.
Both transports (REST and git) behave identically for the new identity fields.
Live dry-run against the real viro-agent-control branch proves claims, heartbeats, briefs and advances still work for an ordinary worker.
evidence: Unit test output for orchestrator-core lease logic
Backward-compatibility demo with a pre-change state file

builder.notes: Governance-engineering packet; deployed by the Orchestrator in wave 2 to avoid control-plane churn during first product wave.

delta.before: Identity by convention; no core lease-logic unit tests.
delta.after: Session-bound identity with refusal on duplicate live identity, tested core logic, backward-compatible state.
regression_protection: Ordinary claim/heartbeat/advance/reject flows unchanged and dry-run proven
